full_judgment:
5. The pre-emptee-petitioner resisted the pre-emption application by filing written statement denying most of the allegations of the pre-emption application contending, inter-alia; that the case land originally belonged to Simad Miah, Thanda Miah, Sydur Haque and others; Samad Miah and Thanda Minh transferred their share to Ezahar Meah by registered patta dated 14-6-1940 and Sydul Haque also transferred his share to Ezahar Meah by registered patta dated 2-6-1934 and after the death of Ezahar Meah his son Kanchan Miah alias Motahar Mean inherited the entire land and accordingly, his name finally published in BS Khatian. Thereafter, Kanchan Miah transferred the case land to the pre-emptee-petitioner on 6-7-2005 by registered deed with the full knowledge of the pre-emptor and other co-sharers and after purchasing the property the pre-emptee-purchaser mutated his name by opening mutation Khatian No. 2645. The pre-emptee purchaser has many lands surrounding the case land and that he is not a stranger to the case land. It has been also stated that the pre-emptor-opposite party is not a co-sharer at all and, as such, the case is liable to be dismissed. 

 19. On going through the pre-emption application and written objection, it appears that the case land originally belonged to Samad Miah, Thanda Miah, Sydur Haque and others; Samad Miah and Thanda Miah transferred their share to Ezahar Meah by registered patta dated 14-6-1940 and Sydul Haque also transferred his share to Ezahar Meah by registered patta dated 2-6-1934 and after the death of Ezahar Meah his son Kanchan Miah alias Motahar Meah inherited the entire land and accordingly, his name finally published in B.S. Khatian, who sold out the case land to the pre-emptee-petitioner on 6-7-2005 by registered deeds and father of the pre-emptor named Alhaj Mvi. Md Harun Islamabadi purchased the land from the brother of Motahar (brother of Kanchan Miah) from the case holding by registered deeds dated 9-10-1997, 19-6-1997, 21-1-1998, 5-8-1997 and 13-4-1997 and in this way the father of the pre-emptor became co-sharer to the case holding in the year 1997 and the pre-emptee purchaser became co-sharer to the case holding in the year 2005. It further appears that both the parties after purchasing the land from parent joma mutated their names.
